github-actions.description: CI here is Depot, whose workflows live in .depot/workflows/ rather than .github/workflows/. The stock github-actions manager only scans the latter, so action pins in the Depot workflows would silently never update.

packageRules.description: Base images are pinned by digest so the runner image's layer delta stays small (see runner/Dockerfile). Renovate is what keeps those digests from going stale; without it the pin is a freeze.
A base-image major/minor move changes the runtime under the runner (Node engine, glibc). Review those.
Action pins in the Depot workflows: patch/minor are safe to take automatically.
